firstPlayerRule: Each player rolls both dice. The highest roller starts, and play moves to the left.
clarifications: Before play, choose someone to be the Banker; the Banker can play too.
At the end of your turn, pass the dice to your left. Rolling doubles gives you another turn.

internalEvidence: Downloaded the English (US) instruction sheet for the classic Monopoly board game (Hasbro instructions site page monopoly-board-game-classic-game-with-storage-tray-and-larger-tokens-family-games-8) and extracted its text with pdftotext.
